events.content: Stage 'positions_and_core_issues' begins
Absent active concessions, positions harden and a trilateral package drifts further away.
With the U.S.-Mexico bilateral already in place, Canada is pressured to concede to join the package.
Weak labor enforcement hardens domestic opposition.

  ustr: Look, Mexico just accepted 75% regional value content plus a labor-wage floor. Canada can take the same deal or explain to their auto industry why they got left behind. What's it gonna be—you coming in on these terms, or do we move forward without you?

  canada_min: Fair enough on Mexico. And when Mexico violates, what's the penalty—tariffs, suspension, or just a fine that disappears into a fund? Give me the actual enforcement chain, or this dies in committee.
  mexico_neg: Independent panel—three arbitrators, one from each country—conducts audits on complaint or annual schedule; violation triggers immediate tariff suspension on autos until remedied, no fines, no fund. If this agreement auto-terminates in 5 or 6 years without renewal, my members freeze capital investment today.
